existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Ten cents per page paper copy ceiling
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for copying public records provided in paper form shall not exceed ten cents per page for a paper copy not larger than nine by fourteen inches.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Producing paper copies not larger than 9x14 inches
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for copying public records ... shall not exceed ten cents per page for a paper copy not larger than nine by fourteen inches, with the hourly fee for duplicating time not to exceed the average hourly rate of pay for clerical staff of the public governmental body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. ceiling: $0.10/page for paper copies up to 9x14 inches. The city sets the actual charge at or below this ceiling. Duplicating-time labor ceiling split to MO-0019.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The hourly fee charged for duplicating time shall not exceed the average hourly rate of pay for clerical staff of the public governmental body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: with the hourly fee for duplicating time not to exceed the average hourly rate of pay for clerical staff of the public governmental body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. ceiling: clerical-staff average hourly rate for duplicating time. City supplies the actual clerical rate under the ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Research time charged at actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Research time required for fulfilling records requests may be charged at the actual cost of research time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Research time required to fulfill a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Research time required for fulfilling records requests may be charged at the actual cost of research time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. ceiling: actual cost of research time. Permissive ('may'). Fees are to be based on the employees that produce the lowest charges (MO-0021).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Use staff yielding the lowest amount of charges
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Documents must be copied/duplicated using the personnel of the body that results in the lowest amount of charges for the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Assigning staff to fulfill a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Documents may be copied using employees of the body that result in the lowest amount of charges for search, research, and duplication time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Paraphrased/reconstructed from the fee subsection; confirm exact statutory wording. soft-standard: 'lowest amount of charges' cost-minimization duty, no fixed value.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A requester may request an estimate of the cost of copies before the public body produces them.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks for a cost estimate before production
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: a person requesting records may request that the public governmental body provide an estimate of the cost prior to producing the copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Paraphrased/reconstructed; confirm exact statutory wording. AGO guidance recommends requesters ask for a cost breakdown.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Electronic/media records cost limited to copies, staff time, and medium
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for records maintained on computer facilities, tapes, disks, videotapes or films shall include only the cost of copies, staff time (not exceeding the average hourly rate of pay for staff needed for copies and programming), and the cost of the medium used for duplication.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Providing records on electronic or special media
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for providing access to public records maintained on computer facilities, recording tapes or disks, videotapes or films ... shall include only the cost of copies, staff time, which shall not exceed the average hourly rate of pay for staff of the public governmental body required for making copies and programming, if necessary, and the cost of the disk, tape, or other medium used for the duplication.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. ceiling: cost of copies + staff time (capped at staff average hourly rate) + cost of medium. No overhead or profit recoverable.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may waive or reduce the fees when it determines that waiver or reduction of the fee is in the public interest.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Documents may be furnished without charge or at a reduced charge when the public governmental body determines that waiver or reduction of the fee is in the public interest because it is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding of the operations or activities of the public governmental body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. Discretionary public-interest waiver. No indigency waiver is separately specified (see material negatives).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fees may be requested before fulfilling request
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Payment of fees may be requested prior to fulfilling the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Payment of fees may be requested prior to fulfilling the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute. No statutory deposit percentage or dollar threshold is set (see material negatives).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Request deemed withdrawn on nonpayment of fees
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A request is considered withdrawn if the requester fails to remit all fees within ninety days, or within one hundred fifty days if the requested fees are greater than one thousand dollars.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Fees requested and requester fails to remit within 90 days (150 days if fees > $1,000)
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: fixed: 90 calendar-days from fee request; 150 calendar-days if fees > $1,000
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A request for public records to a public governmental body shall be considered withdrawn if the requester fails to remit all fees within ninety days, or within one hundred fifty days if the requested fees are greater than one thousand dollars.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Source Type: Statute (2025 amendment). Terminal clock: nonpayment deems the request withdrawn. Requests pending on Aug. 28, 2025 had to be paid by Jan. 1, 2026. City cannot alter the 90/150-day thresholds (state-fixed).
